description: `createShare`: `created_by` MUST resolve to a non-revoked `usr_id` (docs/shares.md §createShare/Validation; ADR 0012). Asserts ONLY the accepted MUST: a revoked creator is refused; an active creator succeeds. NOT asserted: the suspended-creator case (shares.md says only SHOULD; making it MUST needs a pending spec clarification). Requires a share store backed by a user registry (the Postgres store; in-memory share stores have no usr table) — harnesses run this file against Postgres, with identity ops `create_user` / `revoke_user` against the same database. Error name PROVISIONAL: `PreconditionError` (existing Node/Python/PHP/Java Postgres precedent), to be pinned by a pending spec clarification. OBJECT ID FORMAT: `object_id` is a wire-format id with an application-defined prefix (`doc_<32hex>`), which every SDK's share store accepts via `decodeAny` (spec#8 resolution); a bare UUID is deliberately avoided because acceptance of bare UUIDs differs across SDKs and is part of the open `object_id` (UUID vs opaque) question, which this fixture must not depend on.

tests.description: A revoked user cannot mint a share.
Known positive: an active user mints a share.
